title: Border and Extraction
author: Tamsin Underhill
blurb: Mara Whitlock, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
